input.quote: Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use restriction binds us; Section 12.3 affirmatively preserves our freedom to build, buy and compete in any field or territory. The only countervailing restraint is the exclusivity language in Section 2.2, which we have addressed under EXCLUSIVITY.

input.quote: Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
input.rationale: Section 2.2 imposes full-term exclusive dealing on us for an entire service category with no performance-based exit — our walk-away position. It also contradicts Section 2.1 (no purchase commitment) and Section 12.3 (no exclusivity commitment). We have proposed deleting it, with a narrowed category/12-month/service-level-exit fallback if Vendor needs protection.

input.quote: Customer shall offer Vendor terms no less favourable than the best terms Customer offers any other technology supplier.
input.rationale: The MFN runs the wrong way: it obliges us to extend Vendor the best terms we give any other technology supplier, open-endedly and with no product limit or comparison carve-outs — our walk-away position. It also conflicts with the no-most-favoured-customer acknowledgement in Section 12.3. We have proposed deletion.

input.quote: For eighteen months after termination Customer will not solicit or engage any person employed by Vendor at any time during the term.
input.rationale: The non-solicit binds only us, runs 18 months post-termination, covers any person employed by Vendor at any time during the term, bars "engaging" them (an effective no-hire) and has no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out. We have narrowed it to the fallback: mutual, 12 months from the end of a person's involvement, involved personnel only, with carve-outs and no no-hire.
